artifact_schema.description: A sealed bound record, schema ecbench.bound/v1, as aburan28/crypto's ecbench writes it with `ecbench bound fit --unit bitop/v1` (docs/bounds/README.md there), with every non-integer number carried as its shortest round-trip decimal string, because this network's canonical encoding has no floats. artifacts/prime-rho-neg.json is a committed record rendered that way and scores 682064; artifacts/prime-bsgs-neg.json scores 866743; artifacts/tampered-mean-gae.json is the first with one count altered, and is refused.

bound_id.description: ECBND1h followed by 12 hex digits: the measuring repository's SHA-256 of the record's bytes with this field empty. Named, not recomputed here -- the rendering changes the bytes.

domain.description: problem ecdlp.single_target, family prime, target_kind planted, unit bitop/v1, tier toy, envelope one cold target without precomputation.

sizes.description: One row per curve: slug, r, field_bits <= 32, automorphisms_available, floor_s, runs == verified > 0, mean_gae (mean bitop/v1 gates of a run), mean_s (= mean_gae / (sqrt(r) * gates of one affine addition on a field_bits-bit F_p)), ratio_to_floor; every stated figure recomputes from the counts.

constant.description: ratio_to_floor.value equals the run-weighted mean of the sizes' ratios.

dimensions.description: ops.known true and ops.value equal to constant.ratio_to_floor.value.

provenance.description: sessions named by directory, session id and the SHA-256 of records.jsonl; verified equal to the sum over sizes.

admissibility.description: status admissible: in bitop/v1 a record whose pricing is incomplete is inadmissible by its own account.

statement: Bring a measured ECDLP method as close to the generic collision floor as the counts allow, in one domain: the ecdlp.single_target problem on prime-field curves with planted targets, in bit operations (bitop/v1: two-input gates per primitive under frozen formulas, aburan28/crypto docs/units/BITOPS.md; the whole method, cold, one target, no precomputation, every operation it performs priced and none left out), at the toy tier (fields of at most 32 bits). Submit a sealed ecbench bound record (schema ecbench.bound/v1, unit bitop/v1) with its non-integer numbers as decimal strings. Score is parts per million of the floor sqrt(pi / 2A) sqrt(r) additions achieved, maximised: the pinned evaluator recomputes every size's S = mean gates / (sqrt(r) * gates of one affine addition) and its ratio to the floor from the record's own counts, the pooled ratio from the sizes, the tier from the field sizes and the domain from its fields, so a declared headline counts for nothing. A record that disagrees with itself, measures time, lies outside this domain or tier, or is not admissible (an incomplete bit-operation price is inadmissible) scores 0 and is rejected. Baseline 500000, target 1000000, the floor itself. The evaluator cannot verify that the sessions a record names exist and replay -- that is the measuring repository's CI and a replay receipt cited by hash inside the record -- so an accept is a receipt for a well-formed, self-consistent frontier entry and nothing stronger. Payment is proportional to the distance the frontier moves, and every submission must cite the frontier it beat.
